notes.notes:
[b]Istoria[/b] is finished for now...

It took much longer than planned and for that i'm deeply sorry.
I have learned so muchen during this time and i hope i can proof that with my next project.

The game ofcouse i not all i wanted it tobe - but it will forever my first steam game!

A [b]big[/b] thanks to everyone who has supported me during this time!

-Andreas [b]"Ascha"[/b]
